summary: Comprehensive testing of IR Thermography Background PDF Generation feature completed. All 8 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Download PDF button works correctly on both AuditReports page and IRThermographyForm page. The implementation successfully solves Cloudflare 524 timeout issues by using background job processing for large reports.

minor_code_issues.issue: Some alert() calls remain for non-PDF features (clone, delete, email) - lines 242, 245, 384, 401, 681
minor_code_issues.note: PDF download correctly uses toast notifications

critical_code_review_comments: PDF download functionality correctly uses toast.info(), toast.success(), and toast.error() instead of alert()
Background PDF generation uses hybrid storage: in-memory dict for real-time updates + MongoDB for persistence
Frontend correctly handles both direct download (<20 items) and background generation (>=20 items or timeout)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Download PDF button works on both AuditReports and IRThermographyForm pages)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Background PDF generation feature fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) POST /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/generate creates job and returns job_id immediately (200 OK), 2) GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/status/{job_id} returns status (queued -> processing -> completed), 3) GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_id}/pdf/download/{job_id} returns actual PDF file (~2MB), 4) Jobs are persisted to MongoDB pdf_jobs collection, 5) Frontend uses direct download for small reports (<20 items) and background generation for large reports (>=20 items), 6) Frontend shows loading spinner during background generation, 7) Toast notifications used for PDF download feedback (not alert()).

features_verified.GET /api/ir-thermography-report/{report_: PASS - Returns status transitions (queued -> processing -> completed), progress, filename, size_bytes, download_url

implementation_details.backend_approach: Hybrid approach - in-memory dictionary for real-time status updates during processing, MongoDB for persistent storage of completed PDFs
implementation_details.frontend_approach: For reports with <20 items: direct download with 90s timeout. For reports with >=20 items or timeout: background generation with polling
implementation_details.timeout_solution: Background job processing avoids Cloudflare 524 timeout by returning job_id immediately and generating PDF asynchronously

end_to_end_flow_verified.step_3: Backend creates job in memory and MongoDB, returns job_id immediately
end_to_end_flow_verified.step_4: Backend starts background PDF generation task
end_to_end_flow_verified.step_7: PDF file is downloaded to user's browser
